biography.value: A World Pillar is the elemental concept of stone given will and scale. It does not fight — it removes things from the fight permanently. World Crush at Margin 2 immediately Engulfs with no save and no preliminary steps. Continental Hurl controls entire approach corridors. DR 9 plus Stone Skin plus regeneration plus elemental immunities means the only meaningful way to damage it is magical. A summoner who calls one has made a decision about what this location will look like when the World Pillar is done with it. That decision is largely irreversible once made.

system.attacksNotes:
World Crush [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 20 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 20 damage (12 + 8 Str).
  • Margin 2: 20 damage, DR halved (round up); target immediately Engulfed (Grappled + Restrained + Prone + Blinded); 10 bludgeoning damage per round; no save; Might check (Hard task, 2 successes) as full [Combat] action each round to escape.
  • Margin 3: 20 damage, DR halved (round up) + Engulfed; damage increases to 14 per round; escape requires ally excavation (4 [Interact] actions).

Continental Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 2 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 150/300 ft, 20-foot diameter.

  • Margin 1:: 20 bludgeoning damage (18 + 2 Dex) + Prone.
  • Margin 2: 20 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 20 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Stunned + Restrained for 1 round by debris; all creatures within 20 feet take 16 bludgeoning damage.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Immovable: Cannot be knocked Prone or moved. Earth Bond: While on natural earth or stone, regains 12 HP at the start of its turn. Suppressed if it took magical damage this round. Powerful Build: World Pillar counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Stone Grip: Creatures Grappled by the World Pillar add 5 to both dice on Athletics, Acrobatics, and Might checks to escape. Continental Tremor (1/day) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, releases the earth's full force in an 80-foot diameter. Every non-designated creature on natural ground makes a Fortitude [Hard] save.

  • Margin 1:: 10 damage only.
  • Margin 2: 10 damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone.
  • Margin 3: 10 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Restrained for 1 hour; requires excavation to escape.

Piercing and Slashing Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 4 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical piercing and slashing damage while within 60 feet. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
system.reactionsNotes: Stone Skin [Reaction]: Once per round, reduce incoming physical damage by 14. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the World Pillar fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.
